label: Bible Study
prompt: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all _____, no man forbidding him.
verse: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
note: The last verse of Acts — Paul under house arrest in Rome, still preaching freely.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath _____ to all men,
verse: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
note: Grace isn't hidden or exclusive — Paul tells Titus it has appeared to all men.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the soldiers _____ a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
verse: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
note: The KJV spells it 'platted' — the soldiers wove a crown of thorns and added a purple robe to mock the King.

label: Deep Water
prompt: That if thou shalt _____ with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verse: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
note: Mouth and heart together: Paul's simplest summary of how a person is saved.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Blessed is he whose _____ is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verse: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
note: David's song of forgiveness opens with a blessing on the one whose 'transgression' is forgiven. Paul quotes it in Romans 4:7.
